title: THE THORN CLOSEOUT -- the cluster sector's complete accounting for the MNRAS cluster section: the closed form assembled, the open items named, the paper-ready statement, the final scorecard
question: Assemble the sector's closed form M_dyn(<r) = M_b(<r) + M_ph(<r) + M_dust(<r); state the remaining open items honestly; write the one-page paper-ready statement a referee can check; deliver verdicts V1 (closeout complete), V2 (paper-ready), V3 (the scorecard: DERIVED / MEASURED / PENDING).
context: COMPILATION ONLY -- every number is committed and re-cited from its provenance lane (G095/G098/G108/G122/G135/G137/G139/G140/G143/G154/G159/G176/G177/G178/G179/G180/G182/G184/G185/G186); nothing new is derived or downloaded in this lane; nothing written outside deepseek_push/.

the 12-decade line's unfilled 5.4%-of-span sliver log M 13.07-13.70 between the most massive groups and least massive clusters; 2.89 -> 0.63 dex filled (78%), slope 1.004+-0.011 on n = 542; seam residual +0.115 groups -> +0.273 clusters (a gentle rise, no step); OPEN BY DATA, not by law

decision tree on the sample-median 2-bin slope [R500,2R500]: (-2.94,-2.14) JOINT (center -2.54+-0.4) / phantom-only -1.44-class / steeper neither; two-sector Delta chi2 = 2290 = 47.8 sigma pooled (shape-only); ASYMMETRIC falsifiers: F2' (dust-kill) 4.4-6.9 sigma, F1' (steeper/neither) 1.7-2.6 sigma; all inputs public today, ~2-4 weeks per survey

V1_closeout_complete.statement: THE CLOSEOUT IS COMPLETE: the closed form M_dyn = M_b + M_b(r/r_M) + M_dust(c0,q) is fully assembled -- phantom DERIVED (Gauss-map charge), dust MEASURED (two-parameter law, 0.1-dex floor), amplitude PINNED by the derived jump (A_b = 0.650 -> c0, R = 1.09, 12/12), seam/saturation/phase diagram DERIVED, pie closed (17.7/56.9/24.6), 2/3 temperature law measured on 31 systems, outer slope -2.404+-0.078 at 7.7 sigma vs NFW; the open items are named and bounded (q, the 0.63-dex sliver, the inside-R500 degeneracy, the tSZ 3-way verdict).

V2_paper_ready.statement: THE PAPER-READY STATEMENT STANDS: CLUSTER_CLOSEOUT.md section (3) is one page a referee can check -- every number carries its provenance row, the two-parameter dust law, the derived amplitude (the infall-jump chain with errors), the phase diagram with its falsifier, and the falsifiable outer slope are stated with windows and errors.

V3_honest_statement.statement: THE FINAL SCORECARD -- DERIVED: M_ph = M_b r/r_M (Gauss-map charge), A_b = 0.650 (infall-jump chain, within 1.34x), the seam r_t = 0.96 r_M, the saturation M_sat = 3.09e14, the 2/3 exponent, the u-exponent +0.31 = (1-gamma)/2 - 1/3, the r^-1 dust shape, the phase structure. MEASURED: (c0, q) = (-0.145, -0.414) over 38 systems with c0's combination pinned (R = 1.09), the pie 17.7/56.9/24.6 (identity closure), the 0.076-dex 31-system temperature law, the outer slope -2.404+-0.078 (7.7 sigma vs NFW), the phase endpoints. PENDING: q alone (group-scale test), the 0.63-dex sliver (data), the knee position inside R500 (unresolvable; outer slope decides), the tSZ 3-way verdict (ACT/Planck), the 0.1-dex floor, the phase boundary's measured location. THE THORN'S FINAL STATE: effectively closed -- one derived amplitude chain, one measured two-parameter law, ONE open single number (q), ONE pending observation (tSZ), four named caveats.
